newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent rangebound on technicals.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent rangebound on technicals.

text.p: August Brent futures were untraded at midday on Thursday with prices rangebound in quiet Asian trading.
August Brent on SIMEX was quoted at $18.85/18.93 per barrel, after London closed 12 cents higher at $18.92.
IPE Brent had opened lower, gaining some strength at the end of the trading day.
But brokers said that the market was more controlled by technicals.
"Technicals seem to have a bigger effect than the market fundamentals" a broker said.
They expected Brent to trade in the range of $18.75 to $19.00.
NYMEX was thinly traded, with August last traded at $20.28, down from six cents from New York, where the contract had risen 22 cents to $20.34.
